equations.tree: F1 event DAG uses exact ordered sibling tags and three WIN2 node stages; do not add station halfcycles by rounding
equations.slot: slot=(row+8*pos)&63; key=(pos,row16,nseg); retain key from first incomplete F1 through final complete reentry; different keys must not overlap
equations.cap_config: new CFG only after pairing-store drain and all old-config D2 consumers; conservatively after every old CW/VP commit
equations.qr: QR_start(head)>max(VP_commit(all64 tail inputs), VP_commit(all64 coefficients)) with measured command/read ages
equations.q_read: Q_RDOUT_start(word)>max(VP_commit(32 actual input dimensions or QR output), source read-port release)
equations.conservative_retire: RETIRE>=source_epoch_end; earlier issuer-only retirement requires separate proof its reused tag/config state cannot affect in-flight source returns
equations.next_epoch: epoch[p+1].CFG/slot/address reuse >= prior conflicting resource release, not prior heuristic end_iter
equations.deadline: source_epoch_end + actual downstream gather/II4/consumer ages <= original fixed token deadline; otherwise FAIL

conditional_nseg3_tail_bound: Only if arrivals/tree/F5-F11 legal and all3 segments present: last CW <= last ARR +40+2*10+4 = last ARR+64. This is an upper bound on CAP pipeline tail, not a chosen schedule or native return link estimate.
